testimonials.subtitle: Excerpted from Naver Place visitor reviews

t1.short: I finally understood why Kim Yuna's performances were pure art — beauty comes from solid fundamentals and delicacy.
t1.text: The director has incredibly rich teaching experience and explains body mechanics in a way each student can understand. The curriculum is rich and there are multiple instructors, so you hear diverse perspectives on the same movement. Don't hesitate, come learn with us!
t1.author: 리얼초코***25

t2.short: Almost 2 years in — I can't imagine life without tango. We nicknamed it 'El Tango Gym' because you grow every single day while having fun!
t2.text: The music, people, and atmosphere are all amazing. The daily programs are so well-organized it's like a tango gym — you go to have fun and grow seriously. My husband and I started together, and I highly recommend starting with a partner!
t2.author: 순정****

t3.short: Systematic curriculum from basics to advanced, skilled and kind teachers, and a great system connecting classes with práctica and milongas.
t3.text: I've been learning at El Tango for almost 2 years. The tuition is reasonable, and the progression from ELF to Eldorado courses is very helpful.
t3.author: 신*조

t4.short: Visited alone on a friend's recommendation — the Sunday morning guided práctica was amazing. 3 hours flew by!
t4.text: The teacher gave detailed individual feedback and explained things in an easy-to-understand way, so even beginners could join without pressure. About 20 people from their 30s to 60s were practicing together and the atmosphere was great.
t4.author: 용용블루

t5.short: Only 1.5 months in and I had a blast at my second milonga! The foundation classes are really solid.
t5.text: There are many instructors and senior students who really help beginners along. I even danced a vals and milonga tanda!
t5.author: 필라테스애플

t6.short: El Tango is seriously fun. The beginning is tough but once you get through it, just follow along and you'll find yourself dancing well lol
t6.text: The curriculum is well-guided by the teachers, just follow along and you'll be fine.
t6.author: 별그로구

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Can I learn even if I have no rhythm?
faq.a1: Most El Tango students are complete beginners. Our classes start from walking, balance, rhythm, and communication fundamentals. Your body line improves and balance gets better, correcting your posture. Many are first-time dancers in their 40s, office workers, and couples.
faq.a2: 70% of students come alone. Senior helpers will partner with you, so don't worry. Couples can take class together without partner rotation.
faq.a3: Comfortable clothing and clean indoor shoes are all you need. Budget jazz shoes work great too. Men are encouraged to wear a neat shirt as a courtesy for partner dancing.

cruise-2027-tango-preparation.title: Prepare for a 2027 Cruise Party: A Beginner Tango Guide at El Tango Gangnam
cruise-2027-tango-preparation.description: Learn to walk elegantly to music at cruise evening parties. Monday and Wednesday 10:30 a.m. brunch tango classes for beginners in their 50s and 60s.
cruise-2027-tango-preparation.content:
## Your 2027 cruise: join the dancing at the evening party

Imagine arriving at a gala dinner or evening party in a beautiful dress or tuxedo, with a live orchestra playing. Learning a few tango foundations can help you feel ready to join your partner on the floor.

Argentine tango is a social dance built around walking elegantly with a partner and responding to music. You do not need to memorize complex routines to begin. Like Al Pacino in *Scent of a Woman*, you can start by listening to the music and walking together.

### Morning brunch tango lessons for learners in their 50s and 60s

Prepare for your 2027 journey at El Tango, a Gangnam studio with 17 years of history. Morning lessons offer time to move, learn, and enjoy brunch with classmates.

- **Who it is for**: People preparing for a 2027 cruise, couples looking for a shared hobby, and beginners interested in upright walking. The class has an average age in the mid-50s; 90% began as complete beginners.
- **Monday, 10:30 a.m.**: Cruise beginner class, covering basic walking, party etiquette, and elegant poses.
- **Wednesday, 10:30 a.m.**: Cruise choreography class, preparing a complete piece for a party performance.
- **Location**: 2F, 12 Juheung-gil, Seocho-gu, Seoul, a three-minute walk from Sinnonhyeon Station Exit 1.
- **Parking**: Seocho Eongubi public parking, two minutes away on foot; KRW 1,800 per hour, open 24 hours daily.
- **Benefit**: Onnuri gift certificate discounts; check current eligibility and rates before purchasing.

faq.question: Can I learn tango for a cruise party if I have never danced?
faq.answer: Yes. Tango starts with upright walking (caminata) and communicating with your partner. Two to three months of basic lessons can help beginners become comfortable moving to music at a party.

faq.question: Can I join without a partner?
faq.answer: Yes. More than 80% of students start on their own. Classes rotate partners so that you can learn with different classmates without bringing a partner.

latin-shoes-vs-jazz-sneakers.title: Latin Dance Heels or Jazz Sneakers? A Tango Instructor’s Guide to Your First Shoes
latin-shoes-vs-jazz-sneakers.description: Should tango beginners buy heels or low jazz sneakers? Director In-kyung Lee compares ankle comfort, cost, and turning feel after 24 years of teaching.
latin-shoes-vs-jazz-sneakers.content:
## Start your first one to three months in comfortable jazz sneakers

Many beginners picture 7–9 cm Latin or tango heels when they think about tango shoes. High heels can make it harder to find a comfortable balance before you have learned to control your axis.

### Why jazz sneakers can help beginners

1. **Split soles**: Separate forefoot and heel sections let the foot flex more freely.
2. **Cushioning**: Cushioned soles can make walking practice more comfortable.
3. **Spin spots**: Some models have a turning pad designed for smooth turns on a dance floor.

Comfortable jazz sneakers or clean indoor trainers can help you develop foot awareness in the first one to three months. Beginner jazz sneakers often cost around KRW 20,000–30,000. Ask your instructor about fit and floor grip before moving to tango heels.

faq.question: What shoes should I bring to my first tango lesson?
faq.answer: Bring clean trainers or sneakers that have not been worn outdoors, or indoor slipper socks. Wait until after your first lesson to buy dance shoes so your instructor can help you choose a suitable pair.

tango-lesson-cost-duration-guide.title: 2026 Tango Lesson Costs and Learning Timelines: Trial Classes and Onnuri Benefits
tango-lesson-cost-duration-guide.description: A guide to introductory Argentine tango lesson fees around Gangnam, one-day trial classes, and the time needed to prepare for a social tango party.
tango-lesson-cost-duration-guide.content:
## Tango lesson costs and timelines in 2026

Introductory Argentine tango courses around Gangnam commonly cost KRW 100,000–150,000 for four to six weeks, with one 60–80 minute lesson per week.

### 1. A one-day trial class

- **Lesson fee**: KRW 30,000.
- **Review benefit**: A KRW 10,000 refund after posting a Naver receipt photo review, bringing the effective cost to KRW 20,000.
- **Full credit toward a regular course**: Register for a regular beginner course on the day of your trial and the full KRW 30,000 trial fee is deducted from tuition.

### 2. Onnuri gift certificate benefits

El Tango Gangnam accepts Onnuri gift certificates. Purchase discounts and potential income-tax deductions depend on the current program, payment method, and eligibility; confirm the applicable terms before paying.

faq.question: How long does it take to dance at a milonga?
faq.answer: Students typically spend the first one to two months learning walking and the embrace (abrazo), then add turns and changes of direction in months three and four. Around six months of practice can help you feel ready for social tango parties, though progress varies.

office-workers-posture-tango-wellness.title: Argentine Tango for Office Workers: Posture, Walking, and Everyday Wellness
office-workers-posture-tango-wellness.description: A music-led movement hobby for office workers in their 40s and 50s who want to practice upright walking and take a break from screens.
office-workers-posture-tango-wellness.content:
## Practice upright walking through tango

After a day at a computer, tango offers a chance to focus on movement and music. Lessons begin with standing comfortably and walking (caminata), before introducing more elaborate steps.

Paying attention to your feet, pelvis, and balance can help build awareness of how you stand and move. Walking with music for an hour is also an opportunity to step away from screens and enjoy a shared activity.

Tango is a movement hobby rather than a medical treatment. Choose a comfortable pace and tell your instructor about any movement limitations.

faq.question: Can I dance tango if I have back or knee problems?
faq.answer: Tango lessons can focus on gentle walking, but whether dancing is suitable depends on your condition. Ask a healthcare professional before starting if you have a disc problem, ongoing pain, or a knee injury, and tell your instructor so the lesson can be adapted.
